headline: Status Yellow - Rain warning for Leinster, Munster
description:
Heavy rain associated with Storm Austen will spread eastwards across the country. Strong easterly winds will back northwesterly and strengthen further, especially in the south and southeast.

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
  • Outdoor events impacted
  • Debris, loose objects displaced
  • Some fallen trees, branches

headline: Small Craft warning for all coasts of Ireland
description: East to northeast winds veering northwesterly will reach force 6 or higher at times.

headline: Status Orange - Rain warning for Cork, Kerry, Waterford
description:
Intense rain associated with Storm Austen.

 

Prepare for impacts:

  • Disruption and delays to public transport (rail, bus)
  • Flooding expected
  • Very difficult travelling conditions
